description:
The master Phase 0 research protocol.

Field declaration order is the canonical serialization order.
The ``$schema`` field is aliased to ``schema_version`` so that JSON
output contains the ``$schema`` key required by the JSON Schema spec,
while Python code uses the valid Python identifier ``schema_version``.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema (relative kit path, resolved locally by the validator)
$schema.title: $Schema

playbook_type.description: Canonical research archetype driving default parameters

metadata.description: Freeform project metadata (title, researcher, venue, timeline)
metadata.title: Metadata

research_questions.description: At least one research question is required
research_questions.title: Research Questions

matrix_dimensions.description: Custom extraction dimensions (empty list = no extraction configured)
matrix_dimensions.title: Matrix Dimensions

title: ResearchProtocol

ConceptCluster.description: Conceptual keyword cluster with boolean operator for query expansion.
ConceptCluster.title: ConceptCluster

DimensionDataType.description: Supported data types for extracted matrix dimensions.
DimensionDataType.title: DimensionDataType

EpistemologyConfig.description: Epistemological stance, rigor standard, and vocabulary boundaries.

primary_paradigm.description: The dominant epistemological stance for this research

secondary_paradigm.description: Optional supplementary paradigm (e.g. for mixed-methods designs)

unit_of_analysis.description: The concrete entity being studied, e.g. 'Software developer commit diffs'
unit_of_analysis.title: Unit Of Analysis

trustworthiness_framework.description: Quality / rigor framework, e.g. 'PRISMA 2020', 'Lincoln & Guba', 'Hevner DSR'
trustworthiness_framework.title: Trustworthiness Framework

epistemological_rationale.description: Narrative justification for the paradigm choice
epistemological_rationale.title: Epistemological Rationale

incompatible_concepts.description: Terms suppressed from search / synthesis under this paradigm
incompatible_concepts.title: Incompatible Concepts

EpistemologyConfig.title: EpistemologyConfig

MatrixDimension.description:
Dynamic, domain-customisable matrix extraction dimension.

These dimensions drive the RAG extractor in Phase 2.  They are inert
configuration in Cycle A — no pipeline reads them yet.  ``matrix_dimensions``
defaults to an empty list, which is a valid (warnings-only) state.

id.description: Unique slug used as the extraction column key, e.g. 'sample_size'
id.title: Id

description.description: Guidance to the RAG extractor on what text to capture
description.title: Description

target_section_category.description: Preferred source section: 'methodology', 'results_empirical', 'discussion_limitations', or 'abstract_intro'.  Null = search all sections.
target_section_category.title: Target Section Category

data_type.description: Expected data type of the extracted value

required.description: When True the extractor flags papers that omit this dimension
required.title: Required

fallback_value.description: Placeholder used when the paper does not report this dimension
fallback_value.title: Fallback Value

MatrixDimension.title: MatrixDimension

synthesis_type.description: How findings will be synthesised, e.g. 'Comparative Matrix', 'Taxonomy', 'Narrative'
synthesis_type.title: Synthesis Type

required_evidence_type.description: Evidence class required to answer this RQ, e.g. 'Quantitative telemetry'
required_evidence_type.title: Required Evidence Type

inclusion.description: At least one inclusion criterion is required
inclusion.title: Inclusion

exclusion.description: At least one exclusion criterion is required
exclusion.title: Exclusion

two_tier_screening.description: When True: Tier 1 = Title/Abstract screen, Tier 2 = Full Text
two_tier_screening.title: Two Tier Screening

ScreeningCriterion.description: A single inclusion or exclusion criterion.

maps_to_rqs.description: RQ ids this criterion serves (must reference existing RQ ids)
maps_to_rqs.title: Maps To Rqs

ScreeningCriterion.title: ScreeningCriterion

core_concepts.description: At least one concept cluster is required
core_concepts.title: Core Concepts

date_range.description: Inclusive year bounds for the search window
date_range.title: Date Range

languages.description: ISO 639-1 language codes; must be non-empty
languages.title: Languages

target_candidate_pool_size.description: Expected size of the initial candidate pool (min <= max)
target_candidate_pool_size.title: Target Candidate Pool Size

retraction_check_required.description: Require retraction watch scan before inclusion
retraction_check_required.title: Retraction Check Required

coi_and_funding_audit_required.description: Require conflict-of-interest and funding disclosure audit
coi_and_funding_audit_required.title: Coi And Funding Audit Required

reproducibility_das_cas_check.description: Require data-availability and code-availability statement check
reproducibility_das_cas_check.title: Reproducibility Das Cas Check

minimum_trust_score_threshold.description: Minimum Phase 4 trust score [0.0, 10.0] for a paper to be included
minimum_trust_score_threshold.title: Minimum Trust Score Threshold
